adaptive_baseline.notes: Standard deviation floor prevents division by zero when sensor is completely stationary or unchanging.

health_score.formula: max(0.0, min(100.0, base_score - penalty_scaling * (w_vib * abs(z_vibration) + w_curr * abs(z_current) + w_temp * abs(z_temperature))))
health_score.notes: Composite health indicator reflecting aggregate standard deviation drift. Configurable heuristic, subject to ablation testing.
